title: One card contract: skeletons, status, failure reason, visible load errors
gap: GenView.tsx:347 says 'Nothing generated in this project yet' while the library is still loading, because items is [] until it is ready. If the library read fails, Library.tsx:116 shows 'Reading this project…' forever and library.state.error is never rendered. SuitesShell.tsx never renders useProjects().error, so a failed /api/workbench/projects looks like 'No project'. Tiles show only name and model (takes.ts:76). Take.status is computed but never drawn, failed takes look like blank tiles, and Generation.error is never shown.
target: A shared TakeTile used by Gen Results, Library and Takes. While loading it shows skeletons at the project's aspect ratio. Each tile carries a status chip (Queued / Rendering / Held / Failed · not billed / Picked / Approved), a one-line failure reason (via the error map in the typed-errors item), and 'Preview unavailable · Refresh' when a take succeeded but has no URL. Project-load and library-load errors show as banners with a 'Try again' button that calls library.refresh() or useProjects refresh.
respects_rules: UI only, built on the existing library store and take model.
